description: Air and ocean freight rates for a shipment with at least one end outside the US / Canada (import or export). Returns every option: mode (AIR / OCEAN), service (e.g. STANDARD, LCL), door service (door_to_door, door_to_port, port_to_door), price, transit days, ports and how long the rate is valid. door_to_port and port_to_door prices do NOT include charges at the far port; tell the user that plainly, and the user must accept those charges before booking. Pricing runs live and can take up to a minute. For domestic US freight use compare_modes or ltl_quote instead. Book the user's chosen option with international_book. Requires a signed-in Warp account.

items.description: One entry per group of identical pallets / pieces

quantity.description: Number of identical pallets / pieces in this line

stackable.description: Whether units can be stacked. Defaults to false.

city.description: City. Needed outside the US / Canada.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, CN, DE

latitude.description: Latitude, improves pricing outside the US / Canada

zipcode.description: Postal code. Required where the country uses one (see international_settings).

name: international_quote
title: Get International Rates (Air / Ocean)
